text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Lembaga

Koko Malaysia (Pengkompaunan Kesalahan) 2013.

Kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun

2. Kesalahan-kesalahan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama ditetapkan sebagai

kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun.

Tawaran dan penyetujuterimaan kompaun

3. (1) Suatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun suatu kesalahan hendaklah dibuat

dalam Borang 1 Jadual Kedua.

(2) Seseorang yang menyetuju terima suatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun

suatu kesalahan hendaklah mengemukakan bayaran bagi kompaun itu dengan

menggunakan Borang 2 Jadual Kedua.

Pembayaran kompaun

4. (1) Jika suatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun kesalahan telah dibuat dan

disetuju terima oleh orang yang kepadanya tawaran itu dibuat, dia hendaklah membuat

bayaran yang kena dibayar itu secara tunai atau melalui kiriman wang, wang pos,

pesanan juruwang, pesanan bank atau draf bank kepada Ketua Pengarah Lembaga Koko

Malaysia dan dipalang dengan perkataan "Akaun Penerima Sahaja", dalam tempoh yang

dinyatakan dalam tawaran untuk mengkompaun kesalahan itu.

(2) Pembayaran kompaun hendaklah diserahkan sendiri atau dihantar

melalui pos berdaftar prabayar atau perkhidmatan kurier ke alamat yang dinyatakan

dalam Borang 1 Jadual Kedua.

(3) Suatu resit rasmi hendaklah dikeluarkan bagi tiap-tiap bayaran yang

diterima di bawah subperaturan (1) kepada orang yang kepadanya tawaran untuk

mengkompaun itu dibuat.

Penyampaian tawaran bertulis, dsb., melalui pos

5. Jika suatu tawaran atau dokumen lain disampaikan melalui pos berdaftar

prabayar, tawaran atau dokumen lain itu hendaklah disifatkan sebagai telah diserahkan

pada masa tawaran atau dokumen lain itu akan diserahkan dalam perjalanan biasa pos.

MALAYSIAN COCOA BOARD (INCORPORATION) ACT 1988

MALAYSIAN COCOA BOARD (COMPOUNDING OF OFFENCES) REGULATIONS 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 11(l) of the Malaysian Cocoa Board

(Incorporation) Act 1988 [Act 343], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. These regulations may be cited as the Malaysian Cocoa Board

(Compounding of Offences) Regulations 2013.

Compoundable offences

2. The offences specified in the First Schedule are prescribed as compoundable

offences.

Offer and acceptance of compound

3. (1) An offer to compound an offence shall be made in Form 1 of the Second

Schedule.

(2) A person who accepts an offer to compound an offence shall furnish

payment for the compound by using Form 2 of the Second Schedule.

Payment of compound

4. (1) If an offer to compound an offence is made and accepted by the person to

whom the offer is made, he shall make payment payable by cash or by money order,

postal order, cashier's order, banker's order or bank draft to the Director General of the

Malaysian Cocoa Board and crossed with the words "Account Payee Only", within the

period specified in such offer to compound an offence.

(2) Payment of compound shall be delivered personally or sent by prepaid

registered post or courier services to the address specified in Form 1 of the Second

Schedule.

(3) An official receipt shall be issued for every payment received under

subregulation (1) to the person to whom the offer to compound was made.

Service of written offer, etc., by post

5. Where an offer or other document is served by prepaid registered post, that offer

or other document shall be deemed to have been delivered at the time when the offer or

other document would have been delivered in the ordinary course of the post.
